description: Exploratory PCA composite of the 41 current-state CHQ variables; climate exposure is not added.

preprocessing.standardisation: z-score using the full published score file
preprocessing.input_direction: All variables are the existing 0–1 higher-is-better encodings.

pca.sign_alignment: Composite sign chosen for positive Pearson correlation with the 41-variable equal-weight CHQ.

score_formula: raw = sum_j(normalised explained-variance weight_j * oriented PC_j); score = 100 * clip((raw - P1)/(P99 - P1), 0, 1)
score_range: 0–100; P1/P99 clipping values are frozen from the full source file.
limitations: PCA is exploratory data reduction, not health-outcome or climate-resilience validation.
Median imputation permits a score for every transaction; inspect input coverage alongside the score.
The 41 inputs are current EPC/building attributes and do not include external weather or hazard exposure.
PCA signs and weights are sample-dependent; refitting on a different sample can change loadings.
